title.en: Community Disputes Resolution (Limitation of Powers and Duties) Regulations 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。其中 1 条为官方正文中标注的已废止条文存根（照录）。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Community Disputes Resolution (Limitation of Powers and Duties) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 24 March 2025.

heading.en: Categories or types of unreasonable interference in relation to which specified powers and duties may be exercised or performed

text.en:
2. For the purposes of section 13G(1)(a) of the Act, the categories or types of unreasonable interference in relation to which the specified powers and duties may be exercised or performed are the following:
(a)the causing of excessive noise;
(b)the accumulation or stockpiling, in a place of residence, of excessive or unconstrained things or material that —
(i)a reasonable person would consider to be of low or no value or no utility in the circumstances; and
(ii)is of a nature or in a quantity that causes unreasonable interference to the individual’s neighbour such as excessive smell or the infestation of pests.
[S 582/2026 wef 01/09/2026]
